name: Badger Diversified Metals
old_description: Founded on good old fashioned service and knowledge, Badger Diversified is
about:
Badger Diversified Metals operates from Madison, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 2006. The company has been owned and operated by the same family for decades, tracing its roots to founder LeRoy Klecker. Today, his son Alan Klecker leads the business and continues to work in the same building where products are fabricated, a hands-on approach the company highlights as uncommon in modern manufacturing.

The shop specializes in custom welding, fabrication, and repair services, with a stated focus on producing quality custom products for the HVAC industry. It welcomes walk-in customers and emphasizes that no job is too small, though the facility size, headcount, and typical production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Primary customers are HVAC professionals and contractors who need custom metal components. The company positions itself as a partner that makes every HVAC professional's job easier by providing the right products at the right time.

Badger Diversified says its foundation rests on "good old fashioned service and knowledge," stressing a family dedication to customers, products, and employees that has never wavered. It also commits to being a responsible and caring employer.
